_comment: Preset -> module-folder list. THE single source of truth for what each tier installs (shipkit_init.py reads this + each module's module.json). A preset is just 'install these module folders'. Tiers are start-at OR progress-through: re-run with a higher preset to install the delta. requires[] in each module.json is resolved transitively, so a custom --modules set auto-pulls its prerequisites + shared lib/.

blurbs.core: TIER 1 — plain request/response Mate: core/mate.md + worker agents + crew-safety hooks + the tier-1 depth modules (subagent-roster, pull-requests, review-cycle) + the compound learning loop. No loop, no Bosun, no UI.
blurbs.autonomous: TIER 2 — adds the bg-Mate/Bosun heartbeat kernel (2 role agents, bosun.md, event-driven + bosun-loop doctrine, hooks, mate-lock, bosun_emit, launchers, wake-monitor).
blurbs.ui: TIER 3 — adds the status-surface PWA console (the ui/ tier; its files ship on the stacked UI PR).
